This matches the error pattern of **unsuccessful outputs and repetitive actions in the face of resource access barriers.** Alternative sources, such as looking up the exact DOI via reliable academic resources, should have been prioritized earlier, instead of reattempting similar searches. This initial misstep set the stage for cascading issues in later steps, as the foundational bibliography was never successfully retrieved or accessed.
